title: El poder militar
goal: Read a closing comparison of Brazil, Chile, and Argentina's military governments, plus Uruguay, Bolivia, and Paraguay, and why nearly every one of them eventually gave way.

items: List the traits Brazil, Chile, and Argentina's regimes shared.
Contrast how each of the three regimes ended.
Name Paraguay's Stroessner as the region's longest dictatorship.
Explain the common pressures that eventually ended these regimes.
Use en definitiva to close a multi-point comparison.
